policy: Live provider data may influence XC decision confidence only when the provider is explicitly enabled for machine ingestion. Modeled snow score remains independent. Fresh official closed status may suppress a trail from Best Today; stale provider status never silently overrides the weather model.

nordic-pulse.label: Nordic Pulse
nordic-pulse.note: Enable only after provider-authorized API access is granted. Public Nordic Pulse pages are not scraped.

travel-wisconsin.label: Travel Wisconsin Snow Report
travel-wisconsin.note: Terms limit site material to noncommercial public use and request permission for broader reuse. Parser remains disabled until written permission is received.

three-rivers.label: Three Rivers Park District
three-rivers.note: Three Rivers terms prohibit reuse or republication without prior consent. Parser remains disabled until written permission is received.

cook-county.label: Visit Cook County Winter Trail Conditions
cook-county.note: Rich public conditions exist, but redistribution permission is being requested before machine ingestion is enabled.

minnesota-dnr.label: Minnesota DNR
minnesota-dnr.note: DNR public data access is broad, but its copyright policy requires permission for commercial website reproduction. Enable only for a DNR-authorized feed or license.
